question: Can observed spaced numeric groups supply a consistent, uniquely decodable word/unit dictionary and transfer to books beyond literal copying?
inventory: All canonical source_validation_inventory entries except developer_interview. Numeric runs are observed groups, not established English word boundaries. Duplicate wires have one unit ID and retain all provenance.
unique_decodability: Exact finite residual-state Sardinas-Patterson search with constructive ambiguity witness; no empty codewords; no cap. Check also every recorded unspaced utterance against the full dictionary.
parser: Exact complete dictionary-only parse counts, plus minimum uncovered digits with literal fallback. No inferred new words and no English completion.
wire_codec: Shared sorted numeric dictionary. References:1+ceil(log2(D)) bits; literals:0+4digit bits. Per book choose raw or reference encoding with1bit family and gamma(length+1). Charge dictionary gamma(D+1)+sum(gamma(wordlength+1)+4wordlength) once for standalone total. Unknown digits stay literal.
statistic: Exploratory whole70-book raw4bit baseline minus dictionary-inclusive coded length. Primary maximum across all four frozen dictionaries, recomputed for each null. Also report individual and exposed68+2 diagnostics; no independent semantic holdout claim.

controls.collisions: Reject/resample colliding control words to retain cardinality and exact length histogram; maximum100000 attempts per word, raise on exhaustion.
controls.copies: All game books remain unchanged in each null. Global randomizations act once per unique dictionary group. Ablation removes the same two predeclared group IDs, without reselecting successful matches.

baseline: For each dictionary length histogram, select most frequent distinct substrings of discovery68 books, frequency by overlapping occurrences, lexical tie break. Charge the same explicit dictionary cost. This is a structural compressor without semantic labels, not a translation.
boundary_diagnostic: All exact full-group raw occurrences, all79 compatible imported-code alignments. Report endpoints possible/forced/impossible. Deduplicate exact word+8digit-left/right-context signatures; these contexts still need not be independent. No occurrence is assumed to be a linguistic word merely because it matches digits.
leave_source_out: Remove all groups belonging to each entire source_group. Flag held groups reused verbatim in other sources; also report unseen groups. This is exposed structural transfer, not blind lexical validation.

qualification.gate: At least27/30 exact true-unit recoveries in each uniquely-decodable cell, or27/30 ambiguity detections in planted cells; all wire roundtrips exact. Dictionary is supplied, not inferred. Already exposed authors; paired cases, no new semantic validation.

success: Only independently attested English predictions count as translation. Unique segmentation, compression, short entity references or low randomization p do not identify English meanings. An incomplete45group inventory cannot reject a larger word/morpheme/concept codebook.
